The '''Japrael sector''',<ref name="USW" /> also known as the '''Onderon sector''',<ref name="Aftermath">{{TBB|Aftermath (episode)}}</ref> was a [[sector]] of the [[Inner Rim Territories|Inner Rim]] region of [[the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Japrael system]], which was the location of the [[planet]] [[Onderon]].<ref name="USW" /> By [[132 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TheAcolyteDate}}</ref> the sector was represented in the [[Galactic Senate]] by the [[Praelion]] [[Axut Klem]].<ref name="TAVG" /> During the [[Republic Era|final]] [[Standard year|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic]], it was represented in the Galactic Senate, and during the [[Clone Wars]] in the [[Separatist Senate]], by [[Onderonian]] [[Senator]] [[Mina Bonteri]].<ref name="HoBS">{{TCW|Heroes on Both Sides}}</ref><ref name="Rise of the Separatists">''[[Rise of the Separatists]]''</ref>

{{Sec-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Japrael sector was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel ''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]'', which was written by [[Drew Karpyshyn]] and published in [[2007]]. The sector was confirmed to be [[canon]] in the reference book ''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]''.
